name: Ethan Ashford
original_name: イータン アッシュフォード
source:
The other master at the Ashford residence. Even if he is [url=https://vndb.org/c43388]Nathan[/url]'s twin, he is a lot different from his brother. He likes to dress as a commoner and goes out very often. A cheerful and spiritful boy.

[From [url=http://www.roseverte.net/cafe0/beast/en]Official Website's Characters Page[/url]]
